commands.stage90_known_branches: rc0 clean, rc10 transient unmeasured, rc13 symlink durable fail, rc2 environment durable fail

transient_mapping.evidence: Stage 90 prints UNMEASURED, not PASS or FAIL, and exits 0 for rc10 as required by the hard constraint.
transient_mapping.defect: foundation/gates.sh sees only code 0 and prints PASS stage90; it discards the captured UNMEASURED text. A reader of the aggregate cannot distinguish 'nothing was verified' from a clean PASS.
transient_mapping.required_fix: Teach foundation/gates.sh or its stage protocol a nonblocking UNMEASURED result, or emit a durable machine-readable stage status that the aggregate preserves. Do not map rc10 directly to ordinary PASS text.

rc13.evidence: Stage 90 maps symlink escape rc13 to exit 1 and prints durable evidence defect text.

rc2.evidence: Missing STATUS/sidecar is an environment/input failure and stage 90 maps it to exit 1. It is not a verifier RED, but it must not produce a green foundation run.

consumer_fields.evidence: Stage source records consumer, gate, observed defect classes, and retirement condition.

overall: Stage-local transient semantics are correct; aggregate foundation output loses the distinction and currently overstates rc10 as PASS. The wrapper is not fully honest at the foundation edge until UNMEASURED survives aggregation.
no_claim: No claim that ALL GREEN foundation output means every stage was verified; no claim that rc10 is durable failure.
